==Biography==
Elementz started playing League of Legends during the beta. He first joined team All or Nothing as a sub, then moved onto [[Counter Logic Gaming]] for a year as their support player before being released from the team. He then signed with [[Curse Gaming]] as their support player. On April 20, 2013, after the dialogue with '''Curse Management''', Elementz decided to step down from the support position and [[Rhux]] will be filling that position. Elementz is able to join other teams during the Summer Split trade.<ref>[http://www.reignofgaming.net/blogs/tuck-esports-inquirer/24008-elementz-to-become-free-agent-rhux-in-as-support Elementz to become Free Agent; Rhux in as Support for Curse] ''reignofgaming.net''</ref>

On June 1, 2013, Elementz became the coach of Team Coast, formerly known as Good Game University.<ref>[http://www.reddit.com/r/leagueoflegends/comments/1fha64/team_coast/ ZionSpartan's Reddit Post] ''reddit.com''</ref>

Elementz has moved on from coaching and has started a brand new team, currently called [[Area of Effect eSports]]. His intention is to lead the team into the up-coming Coke Zero Challenger league, and from there qualify for the LCS.<ref>[http://www.twitch.tv/elementz Elementz Twitch TV Stream] ''twitch.tv''</ref>

[[Area of Effect eSports]] disbanded, and Elementz moved to being a free agent and a full time streamer.<ref>[http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NcgQvvRDXQ4&feature=youtu.be AoE disbanding, Elementz moving to a free agent and full time streamer]''youtube.com''</ref>

===2015 Season===
After [[Team Coast]] qualified for the [[Riot League Championship Series/North America/2015 Season/Spring Season|NA LCS spring season]] via the [[Riot League Championship Series/North America/2015 Season/Spring Expansion|Expansion Tournament]], they contacted Elementz to coach them; however, after a long delay due to visa issues he decided not to accept the position and instead pursue creating a new website.<ref>[https://www.facebook.com/CrsElementz/posts/810185442362316 Elementz's Facebook Post] ''facebook.com''</ref>

== Trivia ==
* Maintains a Tier List of champions for League of Legends.
* His smurf account, Liam Neeson, was created because people view him as a lookalike of the actor of the same name.
* Represented North America at the [[Riot World Invitational]] held in Las Vegas. <ref>[http://ggchronicle.com/riot-world-invitational-liveblog/ Riot World Invitational Summary] ''ggchronicle.com''</ref>
* His favorite champion is {{ci|Wukong}}. <ref>[http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oRnLe98r8Bg League of Legends - Pro Player Pick: Elementz Picks Wukong] ''Riot Games''</ref>
* Completed the "Capri Sun Challenge" by drinking 15 Capri Suns in under 15 minutes.
* Has a cooking show on YouTube under the name Chefmentz, he has since uploaded five episodes of this. [http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=b_fcTMidSdo]
* Known as one of the more innovative Supports, he popularized champions like {{ci|Zyra}} and {{ci|Fiddlesticks}} in North America. His other unconventional Support champs include {{ci|Yorick}}, {{ci|Nautilus}}, and {{ci|Lee Sin}}.
* He is 3/4 Nordic with Iceland and Norway and 1/4 English/Scottish. That is why he has an Icelandic last name.
* He was a Lacrosse coach for 8 years prior to being apart of the League of Legends professional scene. [http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=a1tCxLDk8-s]
